name: Mistral Vibe Free
free_limit: Free web and mobile AI assistant with access to Mistral models, limited chat messages and web searches, limited coding sessions, basic image generation/editing, and 100+ connectors; usage allowances are not published as fixed numeric quotas.
watch_out: Free usage is rate-limited and subject to fair-use restrictions. Higher chat, search, image and coding limits require paid plans. Model training and commercial-use conditions should be reviewed before submitting sensitive or client data.
